question: How much did the price of gold rise in 2025, and what records did it set?
text:
Gold rose **about 65% in U.S. dollar terms in 2025**, its biggest annual gain since **1979**. Spot gold gained **64.6%**, while the London Bullion Market Association’s afternoon benchmark rose **67.4%**, ending the year at **$4,368 per troy ounce**. ([sifma.org](https://www.sifma.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/SIFMA-Insights-Equities-and-Options-Monthly-Metrics_December.pdf?utm_source=openai))

- **Intraday spot record:** Gold reached about **$4,550 per troy ounce** on **December 26, 2025**. ([sifma.org](https://www.sifma.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/SIFMA-Insights-Equities-and-Options-Monthly-Metrics_December.pdf?utm_source=openai))
- **London benchmark records:** The afternoon benchmark set **53 new all-time highs** in 2025, peaking at **$4,449** on **December 23, 2025**. It also posted record averages of **$3,431** for the full year and **$4,135** for the fourth quarter. ([gold.org](https://www.gold.org/goldhub/research/gold-market-commentary-december-2025?tag1=Entail&tag2=Entail&tg=SEO&utm_source=openai))
